questions.topic: A date with no year
questions.learningObjective: Identify a date missing its year

stimulus.body: A short reference note on a date with no year is set for a close-reading task. It states: A date without a year is ambiguous across releases. A marginal reminder adds: include the year in the date. Four statements are then offered, and only one of them follows from what the note actually says.

questions.stem: The question turns on what the note above shows about a date with no year. Given the proposal "The date is fine because readers know the current year", which choice is consistent with the evidence in the passage?

options.text: The entry should include the year in the date.
The date is fine because readers know the current year.
options.misconception: selects "The date is fine because readers know the current…" where the rule in the passage requires a different condition

options.text: The entry should use a relative phrase instead.
The entry should remove the date entirely.
options.misconception: hides timing instead of fixing it

questions.explanation: The passage gives the controlling distinction: a date without a year is ambiguous across releases. On that basis "The entry should include the year in the date" is the supported choice. Option B ("The date is fine because readers know the current year") fails because it selects "The date is fine because readers know the current…" where a date with no year requires a different condition; Option C ("The entry should use a relative phrase instead") fails because it replaces precision with vagueness; Option D ("The entry should remove the date entirely") fails because it hides timing instead of fixing it.
questions.hint: Include the year in the date.

questions.stem: This question asks the reader to use “Spot a destructive notice missing its target / Name the project being deleted. / A destructive notice that names nothing”. Which option results?

options.text: The dialog is fine because confirmation is enough.
The dialog should add a countdown.
The dialog should remove the question.
